title: done and evaluate receipts surface open obligations before the evaluation is requested, so an agent waives or satisfies them first instead of losing an evaluation to a later obligation resolution
outcome: done and evaluate receipts surface open obligations before the evaluation is requested, so an agent waives or satisfies them first instead of losing an evaluation to a later obligation resolution
acceptance: When an item under an evaluated policy has open obligations, the surfaces read before an evaluation is requested (held-item `next` and `show`, and the structured facts the host's evaluation request reads from `show --json`) and the `evaluate` receipt name each bounded open obligation by an agent-safe distinguishing label with its check kind and its actual remedy, give the exact open total and the omitted-open count, and say that a waiver or satisfaction recorded after the evaluation's basis voids that evaluation; stock obligations that `done` waives by itself are named as needing no action before evaluation; recording is never refused and the warning survives the minimal receipt under tight budgets

`next` and `show` on a held item list open obligations ahead of the evaluate/done guidance, in dependency order (obligations, then evaluation, then done), and the mcp-dogfood suite covers an item with an open obligation evaluated before its explicit waiver (the evaluation goes stale, a fresh one seals) and after it (waiver-first order seals), plus a stock source-change obligation that `done` waives without voiding the evaluation
docs/features/acceptance-evaluation.md states the order, and the memory evaluation-order-waive-then-evaluate is removed once the receipt guidance ships, as Greg's retired-memories rule asks

completion.summary: Shipped evaluated-completion obligation guidance, bounded agent receipts, tests and documentation; retired the interim memory
